answer: We formulate a protocol where validator stake is locked within an escrow lagoon, governed by state attestations from a randomness beacon. Under identity multiplication across N Sybil instances, a subgame-perfect sable slashing matrix enforces exponential collateral burning upon entropy divergence, rendering marginal expected payoffs strictly negative. Consequently, single-identity attestation constitutes the unique strict Nash equilibrium in adversarial multi-agent environments.
